ComoFunciona.title: How does Gadu Sorteos work?
ComoFunciona.intro: A simple raffle: you choose your numbers, you pay, the organizer confirms, and the winner is drawn from the sold numbers, for everyone to see.
ComoFunciona.wantToOrganize: I want to organize a raffle
ComoFunciona.journeyTitle: From picking a number to collecting the prize.
ComoFunciona.step1Point1: The draw runs only on <key>sold numbers</key>: nobody participates without having paid.
ComoFunciona.step1Point2: You choose your numbers and they are reserved in your name.
ComoFunciona.step1Point3: When the organizer confirms the payment, they become sold and enter the draw.
ComoFunciona.step2Point1: Payment is by <key>bank transfer</key>: we show you the organizer's details.
ComoFunciona.step2Point2: You send the receipt via WhatsApp.
ComoFunciona.step2Point3: The organizer reviews it and marks your numbers as paid. Until then they stay reserved in your name.
ComoFunciona.step3Point1: The organizer runs the draw on the <key>date and time</key> published.
ComoFunciona.step3Point2: The system randomly picks a number from the sold ones.
ComoFunciona.step3Point3: The <key>result</key> is recorded and cannot be changed: once the draw is done, the winner and the date are frozen.
ComoFunciona.step4Point1: The <key>result</key> is published for anyone to see, no account needed.
ComoFunciona.step4Point3: The <key>hash</key> and the seed let you verify that the winner was in the draw.
ComoFunciona.verificationTitle: Verification with hash and committed seed
ComoFunciona.verificationIntro: Before the draw, the organizer publishes the <key>commitment</key>: the SHA-256 <key>hash</key> of a secret seed. That commitment is frozen and cannot be changed or withdrawn.
ComoFunciona.verificationPoint1: The seed is generated before the draw and stays hidden until the reveal.
ComoFunciona.verificationPoint2: At the reveal, anyone can recalculate the winner with the seed and the list of <key>sold numbers</key>.
ComoFunciona.verificationPoint3: An automatic <key>verifier</key> runs in your browser and tells you whether everything matches what was published.
ComoFunciona.technicalIntro: When the draw runs, the database uses the seed along with the list of sold numbers to calculate the winner and reveals the seed. Anyone can recalculate the result and check that the seed was the same one committed beforehand.
ComoFunciona.formulaHint: first 15 hex characters ÷ sold numbers → remainder = winner's position
ComoFunciona.technicalOutro: The database also calculates two SHA-256 fingerprints: one of the complete list of sold numbers and one of that same list together with the winning number. Both are published and frozen on the raffle page, with the exact step-by-step to verify them.
ComoFunciona.notDo1: We don't draw among numbers nobody paid for.
ComoFunciona.notDo2: We don't change the result after the draw.
ComoFunciona.notDo3: We don't sell or share your data with other organizers.
ComoFunciona.notDo4: We don't promise prizes the organizer hasn't published.
ComoFunciona.demoNote: You're in a test environment. No real prizes are played.
ComoFunciona.demoCheck1: Watch the same staging as the live draw.
ComoFunciona.demoCheck2: Set up your scenario with your numbers and prize names.
ComoFunciona.demoCheck3: Publish the hash and verify the result step by step.
ComoFunciona.demoCheck4: Nothing you do here affects real raffles.
ComoFunciona.demoStep1Text: The same ceremony, with the numbers and prizes of your scenario.
ComoFunciona.demoStep2Text: Choose how many numbers and prizes there are, and which ones are sold.
ComoFunciona.demoStep3Text: Publish the commitment and recalculate everything in your browser.
ComoFunciona.demoHow1: Before the draw, the commitment is published: the SHA-256 hash of a secret seed that isn't known yet. The commitment is fixed and cannot be changed.
ComoFunciona.demoHow2: At the reveal, the seed is made public. Anyone can recalculate the hash and check that it matches the published commitment. The result is derived from that seed and the list of sold numbers.
ComoFunciona.demoHow3: The animation you saw doesn't pick the winner: it only displays it. In the interactive tab, the calculation runs entirely in your browser, without querying the database.
ComoFunciona.demoFootnote: No sign-up · isolated environment · hash and verification in your browser

Sorteo.commitmentText: Before the draw, the organizer published the hash of a secret seed. Nobody knows the seed until the draw: when it is revealed, anyone can check that the winner was calculated from it and from the sold numbers. The commitment can no longer be changed.
Sorteo.hashesText: These SHA-256 fingerprints were calculated at draw time and frozen. The raffle seed was also committed before the draw and is now revealed: with the sold-numbers list shown on this page, anyone can recompute the winner and check that it was not chosen after the numbers were known.
Sorteo.verifyStep1: Commitment: calculate the SHA-256 (hex) of gadu:v1|raffle:{raffleId}|seed:{seed}. It must match draw_commitment: that proves the seed was fixed before the draw.
Sorteo.verifyStep2: Sold list: take the sold numbers for this raffle, sorted from lowest to highest, comma-separated with no spaces: n1,n2,...,nN.
Sorteo.verifyStep3: Winner: calculate the SHA-256 of gadu:v1|raffle:{raffleId}|seed:{seed}|numbers:n1,n2,...,nN. Take its first 15 hex characters as a number, divide it by the number of sold numbers and use the remainder as the position (starting at 0) in the sorted list: that is the winning number and it must match the published one.
Sorteo.verifyStep4: Fingerprints: the SHA-256 of gadu:v1|raffle:{raffleId}|numbers:n1,n2,...,nN must be numbers_hash, and the SHA-256 of gadu:v1|raffle:{raffleId}|winner:{winnerNumber}|numbers:n1,n2,...,nN must be result_hash.
Sorteo.verifyStep5: Any difference means the seed, the list or the result was modified after the draw.

LegalTerms.metaDescription: Terms and Conditions of use of Gadu Sorteos for organizers and participants.
LegalTerms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use
LegalTerms.intro: Welcome to Gadu Sorteos (hereinafter, “the Platform”). By accessing, registering or using our services, you agree to comply with the following Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the Platform.
LegalTerms.s1Body: Gadu Sorteos is a technology platform (SaaS) that allows organizers (“Organizers”) to create and manage raffles for products or services, and users (“Participants”) to purchase numbers to participate. Gadu Sorteos is not the seller of the raffled product or the organizer of the raffle, but the provider of the technology tool.
LegalTerms.s2Body: To participate, users must be at least 18 years old and have the legal capacity to contract. Participation by minors is prohibited. By registering, you warrant that the information provided is truthful and up to date.
LegalTerms.s3Reserve: Reservation: when a number is selected, it enters the “reserved” state for a maximum of 48 hours.
LegalTerms.s3Payment: Payment: the Participant must make the transfer and send the receipt to the Organizer via WhatsApp.
LegalTerms.s3Confirm: Confirmation: the number is considered effectively “sold” only when the Organizer validates the receipt and marks the number as paid in the system. Gadu Sorteos is not responsible for forged receipts.
LegalTerms.s4Body: Because numbers are intangible digital goods, no refunds are made once the payment has been validated and the number has been marked as “sold”. If the raffle is cancelled by the Organizer, the Organizer must refund 100% of the amount paid to the Participants.
LegalTerms.s5Body: The Platform uses a draw engine that randomly selects a number from those actually sold. By participating, the user accepts that the result of the draw is final, binding and not subject to appeal. Once the draw has been executed, the result is recorded on the Platform and cannot be altered: neither Gadu Sorteos nor the Organizer can modify it. Before executing the draw, the Organizer publishes the commitment (SHA-256 hash of a secret seed generated by the system); at draw time the seed is revealed and the Platform also publishes the SHA-256 fingerprints of the sold-numbers list and of the result, so that anyone can recompute the winner and verify that it was not chosen after the numbers were known.
LegalTerms.s6Body: Responsibility for delivering the prize rests exclusively with the Organizer. Gadu Sorteos does not participate in shipping logistics or in the quality of the raffled product.
LegalTerms.s7Body: Gadu Sorteos reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Modifications take effect when published on the Platform.
LegalTerms.s8Body: For inquiries, claims or support, you can contact us at: <email>francofsm84@gmail.com</email>.

LegalPrivacy.metaDescription: What data Gadu Sorteos collects, what it uses it for and how to exercise your rights (Law 25.326).
LegalPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
LegalPrivacy.intro: At Gadu Sorteos, we respect your privacy and protect your personal data in accordance with Law 25.326 on Personal Data Protection of the Argentine Republic.
LegalPrivacy.s1Item1: Registration data: full name and email address. Access is through your Google account or a passkey stored on your own device; the Platform does not store passwords or biometric data, only the public key of that passkey.
LegalPrivacy.s1Item2: Contact data: phone number, used exclusively for the WhatsApp payment validation flow.
LegalPrivacy.s1Item3: Transaction data: history of reserved or purchased numbers, amounts and payment status. Receipts are exchanged via WhatsApp and are not stored on the Platform.
LegalPrivacy.s1Item4: Technical data: server and hosting provider logs (for example, IP address) for security and diagnostics, and cookies to keep your session active and remember your preferences.
LegalPrivacy.s1Item5: Identity verification: if verification is enabled and you complete it, your ID document and a selfie are stored in a private space, accessible only to administration.
LegalPrivacy.s2Item1: Manage your account and allow you to participate in raffles.
LegalPrivacy.s2Item2: Facilitate communication between the Participant and the Organizer for payment validation.
LegalPrivacy.s2Item3: Send raffle-related notifications (for example, if you won a prize).
LegalPrivacy.s2Item4: Comply with legal obligations and prevent fraud.
LegalPrivacy.s3Body: Your data is stored on secure servers (using Supabase/PostgreSQL technology and Vercel hosting) with encryption in transit and encryption at rest provided by the infrastructure. We do not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties unrelated to the operation of the raffle.
LegalPrivacy.s4Intro: As the data subject, you have the right to:
LegalPrivacy.s4Item1: Access the data we hold about you.
LegalPrivacy.s4Item2: Rectify your data if it is outdated or incorrect.
LegalPrivacy.s4Item3: Cancel (delete) your account and personal data. You can request this yourself from your profile, under “Account deletion”, and it is resolved within up to 10 business days.
LegalPrivacy.s4Item4: Object to the processing of your data for marketing purposes.
LegalPrivacy.s4After1: When deletion is approved, we delete your personal data and the identity documents you uploaded for verification. Payment and refund records are kept without your name because they are an accounting obligation.
LegalPrivacy.s4After2: Deletion is blocked while you have open raffles, a payment in progress, a pending refund or numbers in raffles that have not ended. The reason is shown in your profile and you can resolve it and request deletion again.
LegalPrivacy.s4After3: To exercise the other rights, or if you cannot log in to your account, write to: <email>francofsm84@gmail.com</email>.
LegalPrivacy.s5Body: We use cookies to keep your session active and remember your preferences. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, although this may affect the operation of the Platform.
